question: How do I configure SSO for the admin panel?
What are the rate limits on the export API?
Can I get a refund for a digital download?
answer: SSO is configured under Admin > Security > Identity providers using SAML or OIDC.
The export API allows 100 requests per minute per API key.
No — digital products are non-refundable once downloaded.
contexts: Admin > Security > Identity providers lets you connect SAML or OIDC for single sign-on.
General admin settings live under Admin > Settings.
Rate limits: export endpoints are limited to 100 req/min per API key.
Import endpoints allow 1000 req/min per API key.
Refund policy: customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.
Digital products are non-refundable once downloaded.
ground_truth: SSO setup is done in Admin > Security > Identity providers via SAML or OIDC.
Export API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per API key.
Digital downloads are non-refundable once downloaded; other purchases allow refunds within 30 days.
